You will hear Jo telling Dad where her friends are going.
Dad: Is Leo going to the station?
Jo: No, Leo is going to the gallery to draw.
Dad: Where is Eva going?
Jo: Eva is going to the library to borrow a book.
Dad: And Sam?
Jo: Sam is going to the zoo with his sister.
Dad: What about Ruby?
Jo: Ruby is going to the grocery store to buy vegetables.
Dad: And Ben?
Jo: Ben is going to the restaurant for lunch.
